name: flutter
description: Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
one_liner: Google's free toolkit for building one app that runs on phones, tablets, web, and desktop from a single codebase.
buyer: A startup founder who needs an app for iPhone and Android but can't afford to pay two separate development teams.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer builds and sells cross-platform MVP apps for small business clients faster than native development would allow.
An agency specializes in Flutter app builds to undercut competitors who quote separate iOS and Android teams.
A SaaS company ships one Flutter codebase as both its mobile app and admin web dashboard.

money_ideas.idea: Run a Flutter app-development agency charging fixed-price builds for small business clients.
Sell pre-built Flutter app templates (e-commerce, booking, social) for quick customization.

steal_this: This is infrastructure, not a product idea on its own — the real weekend project is picking a Flutter starter template and shipping a specific small-business app with it.
